_readme: Effect cards. Write #name in a prompt; expand_prompt.py adds the description as an 'Effects:' sentence. Words only: the model draws a look-alike of the effect, so describe colours, shape, motion and timing precisely. Add your own cards.
black_flash: at the instant of the punch a ring of jagged black-and-red lightning cracks outward from the point of impact, the screen flashes white for one frame then black, debris and dust burst away, the background goes dark
cursed_aura: a swirling dark-purple and blue energy aura wraps around the body and the arms, flickering wisps rise upward like smoke, the outline pulses with light
blue_pull: a glowing blue sphere with a bright white core hovers in the palm, rings of light spiral inward, rubble and dust are sucked toward it in a spiral, the air distorts around the sphere
red_blast: a glowing red sphere charges in the open hand then bursts, a red shockwave ring expands, the ground cracks and everything near it is thrown outward with speed lines
purple_beam: a huge purple-white energy beam fires forward, the edges crackle with violet lightning, the ground is carved into a trench, the screen shakes and the light washes out the background
domain_expansion: the background warps and melts, the scene fills with endless repeating shapes and a dark starry void, hard black-and-white contrast, the character stands calm at the centre as the space around changes
slash_wave: a thin curved white-blue slash arcs through the air leaving a bright trailing line, the target splits with a delay, wind blows debris sideways
impact_shockwave: a one-frame white impact flash, concentric shockwave rings, cracked ground, speed lines radiating from the hit, dust cloud rolling outward
blood_splatter: dark red blood splatters across the frame in a few sharp hand-drawn shapes on the impact frame, droplets fly in an arc and a stain spreads on the ground
